notes: Sasini Plc — Kenyan agribusiness listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE Kenya). Owns ~32,000 ha (~79k acres) of tea, coffee, macadamia and avocado estates in Kericho, Kiambu and Nandi counties + dairy operations. Diversification away from pure tea over past decade has dampened earnings volatility. Fiscal year ends 30 September. KES reporting; figures in KES millions. Tea price downturn FY2023-2024 hit profitability (sector-wide pressure on Kenyan tea auction prices), partly offset by macadamia/avocado growth. Net debt rose modestly post-FY2022 driven by working-capital and replanting capex. Acres ~79k (32k ha including newer macadamia/avocado expansion). Pre-2022 figures show stronger margins on tea-led mix.

periods.notes: FY20: COVID-impacted Q3, recovery into Q4; tea mainstay
FY21: macadamia ramp; tea + coffee firm
FY22: macadamia + avocado export growth, record net income
FY23: Kenyan tea auction prices weakened, macadamia oversupply pressure
FY24: continued tea price weakness, near-breakeven on operating side; restructuring announced
